test_title: PYST 11: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 10 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹1,200 at an interest rate of 3% per month in 1 month.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹1,200

Rate of Interest (r) = 3% per month

Time (t) = 1 month

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P times r times t)/(100) 

**Calculation:**

SI = (1200 times 3 times 1)/(100) 

⇒ SI = (3600)/(100) 

⇒ SI = 36

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
